# OpenAI API Pricing

GPT-4o: $2.50 / 1M input tokens, $10.00 / 1M output tokens.
GPT-4o mini: $0.15 / 1M input tokens, $0.60 / 1M output tokens.
Previous GPT-4 rates of $30/$60 are superseded.

payload.title: FTC Non-Compete Clause Rule Proceedings
payload.content: Update: On August 20, 2024, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas set aside the FTC Non-Compete Rule nationwide in Ryan LLC v. FTC.

payload.title: US judge blocks FTC ban on worker noncompete agreements
payload.content: A federal judge in Texas blocked the FTC from enforcing a rule banning worker noncompetes, ruling the agency lacked statutory authority.
